update.name: Media Cleaner
update.description: Beheer alle mediabestanden overzichtelijk: vind ongebruikte bestanden, bekijk waar ze worden gebruikt, verwijder ze veilig, maak grote JPG's, PNG's en PDF's kleiner of zet ze om naar WebP, en vind en repareer links naar ontbrekende bestanden en verdwenen websites. --- Manage all media files efficiently: find unused files, see where they are used, delete them safely, make large JPGs, PNGs and PDFs smaller or convert them to WebP, and find and repair links to missing files and websites that are gone. --- Made by Wouter (WoodyF4u). Questions, bug reports or feature requests? Please open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/WoodyF4u/Media-Cleaner/issues
